name: agent-verdict
description: Records Claude Code tool outcomes to a local, private ledger for later review. This version sends nothing over the network.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shadow records everything and never blocks or nudges; enforce may block on strong evidence; off disables recording entirely.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Which System One preset verifies a Stop's completion claims. local-only never calls a provider and only records evidence.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: API key for the selected provider. Falls back to OPENROUTER_API_KEY or TYPESAFE_API_KEY when unset. Never logged or written to the ledger.
